column1: # requires before a pull request merges, one row per verification family.
# before_merge is yes or no. A selected family marked no is reported with its
# reason and recorded as not run; post-merge CI still runs it. Changing what
# the gate needs is a one-line reviewed edit here. Every family preflight can
# run has exactly one row; a family without one fails closed.
